Definition: Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Beth-horon = "house of hollowness"; 1) two towns in Ephraim; 1a) Upper Beth-horon-town on the mountains of Ephraim; 1b) Lower Beth-horon-town located 800 feet (245 m) lower than Upper Beth-horon
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
